mapper.sql:
SELECT s.player_id AS playerId, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.name), ''), p.short_name) AS playerName, p.team_id AS teamId, t.name AS teamName,
#{positionCode} AS position,
(CASE WHEN p.positions IS NOT NULL AND p.positions != '' AND p.positions != '[]' THEN TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(SUBSTR(p.positions, 2, LENGTH(p.positions)-2), '"', ''), '[', ''), ']', '')) ELSE NULL END) AS position,
p.number AS number, COUNT(DISTINCT s.game_id) AS gp, COALESCE(SUM(s.pa), SUM(s.ab), 0) AS pa, COALESCE(SUM(s.ab), 0) AS ab, COALESCE(SUM(s.r), 0) AS r, COALESCE(SUM(s.rbi), 0) AS rbi, COALESCE(SUM(s.h), 0) AS h, GREATEST(0, COALESCE(SUM(s.h), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(s.doubles), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(s.triples), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(s.hr), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(s.inside_park_hr), 0)) AS singles, COALESCE(SUM(s.doubles), 0) AS doubles, COALESCE(SUM(s.triples), 0) AS triples, COALESCE(SUM(s.hr), 0) AS hr, COALESCE(SUM(s.inside_park_hr), 0) AS insideParkHr, GREATEST(0, COALESCE(SUM(s.h), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(s.doubles), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(s.triples), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(s.hr), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(s.inside_park_hr), 0)) + COALESCE(SUM(s.doubles), 0)*2 + COALESCE(SUM(s.triples), 0)*3 + COALESCE(SUM(s.hr), 0)*4 + COALESCE(SUM(s.inside_park_hr), 0)*4 AS tb, COALESCE(SUM(s.so), 0) AS so, COALESCE(SUM(s.sb), 0) AS sb, COALESCE(SUM(s.gdp), 0) AS gdp, COALESCE(SUM(s.sh), 0) AS sh, COALESCE(SUM(s.sf), 0) AS sf, CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(s.bb), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(s.hbp), 0) > 0 THEN COALESCE(SUM(s.bb), 0) ELSE GREATEST(COALESCE(SUM(s.bb_hp), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(s.hbp), 0), 0) END AS bb, COALESCE(SUM(s.ibb), 0) AS ibb, COALESCE(SUM(s.hbp), 0) AS hbp, COALESCE(SUM(s.cs), 0) AS cs, CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(s.ab), 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(CAST(1.0 * SUM(s.h) / SUM(s.ab) AS numeric), 3) ELSE NULL END AS avg, CASE WHEN COALESCE(COALESCE(SUM(s.pa), SUM(s.ab)), 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(CAST(1.0 * (COALESCE(SUM(s.h), 0) + CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(s.bb),0) + COALESCE(SUM(s.hbp),0) > 0 THEN COALESCE(SUM(s.bb),0) + COALESCE(SUM(s.hbp),0) ELSE COALESCE(SUM(s.bb_hp),0) END) / COALESCE(COALESCE(SUM(s.pa), SUM(s.ab)), 0) AS numeric), 3) ELSE NULL END AS obp, CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(s.ab), 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(CAST(1.0 * (GREATEST(0, COALESCE(SUM(s.h), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(s.doubles), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(s.triples), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(s.hr), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(s.inside_park_hr), 0)) + COALESCE(SUM(s.doubles), 0)*2 + COALESCE(SUM(s.triples), 0)*3 + COALESCE(SUM(s.hr), 0)*4 + COALESCE(SUM(s.inside_park_hr), 0)*4) / SUM(s.ab) AS numeric), 3) ELSE NULL END AS slg, CASE WHEN (COALESCE(SUM(s.sb), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(s.cs), 0)) > 0 THEN ROUND(CAST(100.0 * SUM(s.sb) / (SUM(s.sb) + SUM(s.cs)) AS numeric), 1) ELSE NULL END AS sbPct FROM bs_game_player_stat s JOIN bs_game g ON s.game_id = g.id JOIN bs_event e ON g.event_id = e.id JOIN bs_player p ON s.player_id = p.id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN bs_team t ON p.team_id = t.id LEFT JOIN (
) tsg ON tsg.team_id = p.team_id WHERE ( (s.ab IS NOT NULL AND s.ab >= 0) OR (s.pa IS NOT NULL AND s.pa >= 0) ) AND COALESCE(s.is_pitcher, 0) = 0
GROUP BY s.player_id, p.name, p.short_name, p.team_id, p.positions, p.number, t.name

( FLOOR(s.ip) * 3 + (CASE WHEN s.ip - FLOOR(s.ip) < 0.0000001 THEN 0 WHEN ROUND((s.ip - FLOOR(s.ip)) * 10) = 0 THEN 0 WHEN ROUND((s.ip - FLOOR(s.ip)) * 10) = 1 THEN 1 WHEN ROUND((s.ip - FLOOR(s.ip)) * 10) = 2 THEN 2 WHEN ROUND((s.ip - FLOOR(s.ip)) * 10) = 3 AND (s.ip - FLOOR(s.ip)) < 0.31 THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) )

( FLOOR(COALESCE(s.def_inn, 0)) * 3 + (CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.def_inn, 0) - FLOOR(COALESCE(s.def_inn, 0)) < 0.0000001 THEN 0 WHEN ROUND((COALESCE(s.def_inn, 0) - FLOOR(COALESCE(s.def_inn, 0))) * 10) = 0 THEN 0 WHEN ROUND((COALESCE(s.def_inn, 0) - FLOOR(COALESCE(s.def_inn, 0))) * 10) = 1 THEN 1 WHEN ROUND((COALESCE(s.def_inn, 0) - FLOOR(COALESCE(s.def_inn, 0))) * 10) = 2 THEN 2 WHEN ROUND((COALESCE(s.def_inn, 0) - FLOOR(COALESCE(s.def_inn, 0))) * 10) = 3 AND (COALESCE(s.def_inn, 0) - FLOOR(COALESCE(s.def_inn, 0))) < 0.31 THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) )

SELECT s.player_id AS playerId, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.name), ''), p.short_name) AS playerName, p.team_id AS teamId, t.name AS teamName,
ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT s.position::text), '、')
GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT s.position SEPARATOR '、')
AS position, p.number AS number, COUNT(DISTINCT s.game_id) AS gp, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(s.fielding_gs, 0)), 0) AS gs, (CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(), 0) <= 0 THEN 0 ELSE FLOOR(COALESCE(SUM(), 0) / 3.0) + (COALESCE(SUM(), 0) - 3 * FLOOR(COALESCE(SUM(), 0) / 3.0)) / 10.0 END) AS inn, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(s.tc, COALESCE(s.po,0)+COALESCE(s.a,0)+COALESCE(s.e,0))), 0) AS tc, COALESCE(SUM(s.po), 0) AS po, COALESCE(SUM(s.a), 0) AS a, COALESCE(SUM(s.e), 0) AS e, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(s.dp, 0)), 0) AS dp, CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(s.tc, COALESCE(s.po,0)+COALESCE(s.a,0)+COALESCE(s.e,0))), 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(CAST(100.0 * (SUM(s.po) + SUM(s.a)) / SUM(COALESCE(s.tc, COALESCE(s.po,0)+COALESCE(s.a,0)+COALESCE(s.e,0))) AS numeric), 3) ELSE 0 END AS tcPct FROM bs_game_player_stat s JOIN bs_game g ON s.game_id = g.id JOIN bs_event e ON g.event_id = e.id JOIN bs_player p ON s.player_id = p.id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN bs_team t ON p.team_id = t.id WHERE s.position IS NOT NULL AND s.position NOT IN ('P', 'DH', 'PH') AND (COALESCE(s.tc,0) > 0 OR COALESCE(s.po,0) > 0 OR COALESCE(s.a,0) > 0 OR s.e IS NOT NULL)
AND s.position = #{positionCode}
GROUP BY s.player_id, p.name, p.short_name, p.team_id, p.number, t.name
mapper.select:
SELECT g.id AS id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(g.gameday), ''), '') AS gameday, g.home_team_id AS homeTeamId, g.away_team_id AS awayTeamId, g.home_score AS homeScore, g.away_score AS awayScore FROM bs_game g JOIN bs_event e ON g.event_id = e.id WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(g.gameday), ''), '') ASC, g.id ASC
mapper.sql:
SELECT s.team_id AS teamId, t.name AS teamName, COUNT(DISTINCT s.game_id) AS gp, COALESCE(SUM(s.pa), SUM(s.ab), 0) AS pa, COALESCE(SUM(s.ab), 0) AS ab, COALESCE(SUM(s.r), 0) AS r, COALESCE(SUM(s.h), 0) AS h, COALESCE(SUM(s.rbi), 0) AS rbi, COALESCE(SUM(s.doubles), 0) AS doubles, COALESCE(SUM(s.triples), 0) AS triples, COALESCE(SUM(s.hr), 0) AS hr, COALESCE(SUM(s.inside_park_hr), 0) AS insideParkHr, COALESCE(SUM(s.sb), 0) AS sb, COALESCE(SUM(s.cs), 0) AS cs, COALESCE(SUM(s.so), 0) AS so, CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(s.bb), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(s.hbp), 0) > 0 THEN COALESCE(SUM(s.bb), 0) ELSE GREATEST(COALESCE(SUM(s.bb_hp), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(s.hbp), 0), 0) END AS bb, COALESCE(SUM(s.hbp), 0) AS hbp, GREATEST(0, COALESCE(SUM(s.h), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(s.doubles), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(s.triples), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(s.hr), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(s.inside_park_hr), 0)) + COALESCE(SUM(s.doubles), 0) * 2 + COALESCE(SUM(s.triples), 0) * 3 + COALESCE(SUM(s.hr), 0) * 4 + COALESCE(SUM(s.inside_park_hr), 0) * 4 AS tb, CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(s.ab), 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(CAST(1.0 * COALESCE(SUM(s.h), 0) / SUM(s.ab) AS numeric), 3) ELSE NULL END AS avg, CASE WHEN COALESCE(COALESCE(SUM(s.pa), SUM(s.ab)), 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(CAST(1.0 * (COALESCE(SUM(s.h), 0) + CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(s.bb),0) + COALESCE(SUM(s.hbp),0) > 0 THEN COALESCE(SUM(s.bb),0) + COALESCE(SUM(s.hbp),0) ELSE COALESCE(SUM(s.bb_hp),0) END) / COALESCE(COALESCE(SUM(s.pa), SUM(s.ab)), 0) AS numeric), 3) ELSE NULL END AS obp, CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(s.ab), 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(CAST(1.0 * (GREATEST(0, COALESCE(SUM(s.h), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(s.doubles), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(s.triples), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(s.hr), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(s.inside_park_hr), 0)) + COALESCE(SUM(s.doubles), 0) * 2 + COALESCE(SUM(s.triples), 0) * 3 + COALESCE(SUM(s.hr), 0) * 4 + COALESCE(SUM(s.inside_park_hr), 0) * 4) / SUM(s.ab) AS numeric), 3) ELSE NULL END AS slg FROM bs_game_player_stat s JOIN bs_game g ON s.game_id = g.id JOIN bs_event e ON g.event_id = e.id JOIN bs_team t ON s.team_id = t.id AND t.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE COALESCE(s.is_pitcher, 0) = 0
GROUP BY s.team_id, t.name

SELECT s.team_id AS teamId, t.name AS teamName, COUNT(DISTINCT s.game_id) AS gp, COALESCE(SUM(s.gs), 0) AS gs, COALESCE(SUM(s.w), 0) AS w, COALESCE(SUM(s.l), 0) AS l, COALESCE(SUM(s.sv), 0) AS sv, COALESCE(SUM(s.hld), 0) AS hld, (CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(), 0) <= 0 THEN 0 ELSE FLOOR(COALESCE(SUM(), 0) / 3.0) + (COALESCE(SUM(), 0) - 3 * FLOOR(COALESCE(SUM(), 0) / 3.0)) / 10.0 END) AS ip, CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(), 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(CAST( (COALESCE(SUM(), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(s.pitch_bb_hp), 0)) * 3.0 / NULLIF(COALESCE(SUM(), 0), 0) AS numeric), 2) ELSE NULL END AS whip, CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(), 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(CAST(27.0 * COALESCE(SUM(s.er), 0) / NULLIF(COALESCE(SUM(), 0), 0) AS numeric), 2) ELSE NULL END AS era, COALESCE(SUM(s.pitch_bf), 0) AS pitchBf, COALESCE(SUM(s.np), 0) AS np, COALESCE(SUM(), 0) AS pitchH, COALESCE(SUM(s.pitch_hr), 0) AS pitchHr, COALESCE(SUM(s.pitch_inside_park_hr), 0) AS pitchInsideParkHr, CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(s.pitch_bb), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(s.pitch_hbp), 0) > 0 THEN COALESCE(SUM(s.pitch_bb), 0) ELSE GREATEST(COALESCE(SUM(s.pitch_bb_hp), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(s.pitch_hbp), 0), 0) END AS pitchBb, COALESCE(SUM(s.pitch_hbp), 0) AS pitchHbp, COALESCE(SUM(s.pitch_so), 0) AS pitchSo, COALESCE(SUM(s.wp), 0) AS wp, COALESCE(SUM(s.bk), 0) AS bk, COALESCE(SUM(), 0) AS pitchR, COALESCE(SUM(s.er), 0) AS er FROM bs_game_player_stat s JOIN bs_game g ON s.game_id = g.id JOIN bs_event e ON g.event_id = e.id JOIN bs_team t ON s.team_id = t.id AND t.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE s.is_pitcher = 1
GROUP BY s.team_id, t.name HAVING COALESCE(SUM(), 0) > 0

SELECT s.team_id AS teamId, t.name AS teamName, COUNT(DISTINCT s.game_id) AS gp, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(s.fielding_gs, 0)), 0) AS gs, (CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(), 0) <= 0 THEN 0 ELSE FLOOR(COALESCE(SUM(), 0) / 3.0) + (COALESCE(SUM(), 0) - 3 * FLOOR(COALESCE(SUM(), 0) / 3.0)) / 10.0 END) AS inn, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(s.tc, COALESCE(s.po,0)+COALESCE(s.a,0)+COALESCE(s.e,0))), 0) AS tc, COALESCE(SUM(s.po), 0) AS po, COALESCE(SUM(s.a), 0) AS a, COALESCE(SUM(s.e), 0) AS e, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(s.dp, 0)), 0) AS dp, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(s.pb, 0)), 0) AS pb, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(s.catcher_cs, 0)), 0) AS catcherCs, CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(s.tc, COALESCE(s.po,0)+COALESCE(s.a,0)+COALESCE(s.e,0))), 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(CAST(100.0 * (SUM(s.po) + SUM(s.a)) / SUM(COALESCE(s.tc, COALESCE(s.po,0)+COALESCE(s.a,0)+COALESCE(s.e,0))) AS numeric), 3) ELSE 0 END AS tcPct FROM bs_game_player_stat s JOIN bs_game g ON s.game_id = g.id JOIN bs_event e ON g.event_id = e.id JOIN bs_team t ON s.team_id = t.id AND t.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE s.position IS NOT NULL AND s.position NOT IN ('P', 'DH', 'PH')
GROUP BY s.team_id, t.name
